_comment: Every Español story, for the student dashboard (public/dashboard/), which renders its
Español view's cards from this list in this order. The hub (/espanol/) keeps its own
postcards. place, level and blurb are the card's lines; level is the ACTFL level the hub
shows. This file is the CARD TEXT only. Tracking and assigning come from each story's
type 'story' entry in modules-registry.json (same id, url and name; gameNames), and
scripts/check-modules.js fails the build if the two lists differ, or if a story folder
under public/espanol/ is missing from this list.
AA-23 (2026-11-28): code is the city stamp (MTY, MOW, SJO, HAV); focus is the one grammar focus the card
shows; art is the card picture, shared by the hub and the dashboard. /assets/espanol/cards/ is cached for
a year, so a changed picture gets a NEW file name and this field points at it; never replace a file in place.
added (YYYY-MM-DD) is the day the story went live: the dashboard marks a story New for 14 days after it.

stories.name: El Viaje
stories.blurb: Your bag is lost, your interview is at 9:00, and the team wants to take you to dinner.

stories.name: El Mundial
stories.blurb: A hostel full of Argentines, a night train to Saransk, and a stadium of Peru fans. The past tense you pick changes what happened.

stories.name: La selva
stories.blurb: One day trip into the cloud forest: frogs, butterflies, a toucan and five waterfalls. Listen, look, tap.

stories.name: La Habana
stories.blurb: Two verbs for "to be." One very confusing dinner.
